## Final report

Attending the tutoring class changed score gain by an estimated 1.1753994723555934 points for the students who attended the tutoring class. The equal-chance random draw used no information about the units, which supports this causal comparison.

We calculated the raw mean difference (1.1753994723555934 points). For the random comparison, the estimate/difference is 1.1753994723555934 points, SE 0.21517859064857964, with nominal 95% interval [0.75364943468437728, 1.5971495100268096].

The estimate concerns actual participants in this simulated study. Finite-sample uncertainty remains; it does not establish an effect for every individual or other populations.
